name: Sigil of Arathor
summary: The Sigil of Arathor is held by Lieutenant Valorcall, leader of Stromgarde’s cavalry. Zengu in Hammerfall wants it for his search for Trol’kalar.

sections.title: A Cavalry Sigil
sections.body: Lieutenant Valorcall carries the Sigil of Arathor across the Arathi Highlands. He leads the cavalry that serves the human prince and Stromgarde’s defenders. Zengu in Hammerfall seeks the sigil, and Valorcall’s horse lets him cover the countryside swiftly.

sections.title: Zengu’s Purpose
sections.body: Zengu wants the sigil returned to him in Hammerfall. He believes taking it from Valorcall will weaken Stromgarde’s defenders. He also says the sigil brings him one step closer to claiming Trol’kalar.

faq.q: What is the Sigil of Arathor?
faq.answer: The Sigil of Arathor is a token carried by Lieutenant Valorcall, the leader of Stromgarde’s cavalry.
Lieutenant Valorcall carries the Sigil of Arathor as he rides through the Arathi Highlands.
Lieutenant Valorcall rides through the Arathi Highlands, where his horse lets him travel quickly.

faq.q: Who wants the Sigil of Arathor?
faq.answer: Zengu in Hammerfall wants the Sigil of Arathor returned to him.

faq.q: Why does Zengu want the sigil?
faq.answer: Zengu believes taking the sigil will weaken Stromgarde’s defenders and bring him closer to claiming Trol’kalar.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you may hear Zengu in Hammerfall seek the sigil to weaken Stromgarde’s defenders.
